placements.title: Asynchronous Job Lifecycle and Dispatch Contracts
placements.frame: How are asynchronous dispatch, status cursor polling, and result retrieval protocols governed and structured?

placements.title: Immediate Receipts and Polled Cursors Decouple Execution from Client Lifetime
placements.frame: How does the asynchronous remember contract coordinate non-blocking execution, cursor polling, and decoupled result delivery without lost work?
placements.why: Places the ratified architectural shift where remember calls return immediate receipts, jobs are tracked via cursor polling or piggybacked reactions, and client drops do not lose work.
